vedic_reference.note: Lavith is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Radiant, Shining, Bright'. The long meaning of the name is 'सूर्यस्य विकास' (suryasya vikas) meaning 'Sun's Growth' or 'Surya Seva' meaning 'Service to the Sun'.
